draft.title: Text connectives
card: Text connectives are words and phrases that link ideas. They show readers how one part of a text leads to the next.
firstly, next, then and finally show the order of steps or points.
however, but and on the other hand show that the next idea differs from the one before.
as a result, so and therefore show that the next idea happened because of the one before.
draft.remember: A connective tells the reader how the next idea relates to the last one.

a.q: Which connective best fills the gap? Our team trained hard all term. ___, we won the final.
a.why: The win happened because of the hard training, so a cause and result connective fits. However would wrongly signal a contrast, as if the team had not been expected to win.
a.clue: Did the win happen because of the training?

b.q: Jo writes: Mia loves swimming. ___, she dislikes early mornings. Which connective shows the contrast Jo wants?
b.why: Liking swimming and disliking early mornings are two ideas that pull against each other, so a contrast connective fits. Therefore is tempting because it links ideas, but it shows a result, and the second idea is not caused by the first.
b.clue: Do the two ideas agree or pull against each other?
